briefing.text: Preorders for Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo foldable are now open.
Anthropic's IPO valuation talk is reported to have cooled to $1.5 trillion.
Street Fighter took $4 million in Thursday previews despite weak reviews.
Sega is pulling the Total War: Shogun 2 remaster after a poor launch.
Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight model.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO valuation talk is reported to cool to $1.5 trillion
stories.summary: Prospective backers are said to have discussed a $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic's November listing, down from about $2 trillion.
stories.why: It would be one of the largest stock listings ever, and a test of how much investors will pay for AI growth.
stories.happened: Reuters reported that at an investor day in San Francisco, would-be backers discussed a $1.5 trillion price, down from roughly $2 trillion. Q3 revenue was reported at $16.8 billion, up 45% on the quarter, slower than Q2's near doubling.
stories.next: Watch for a filed price range and how investors respond in the run-up to the November share sale.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: A listing at this size would rank among the biggest IPOs on record.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Reported quarterly revenue of $16.8 billion is the yardstick investors are using.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The share sale is reported to be planned for November.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company that makes the Claude family of models.

meme.bottom: Still worth more than most countries
meme.take: Anthropic's IPO price talk slips by $500 billion, which is now apparently a rounding error.

stories.title: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo foldable opens for preorders
stories.summary: Apple's first foldable iPhone is now available to preorder, starting at $1,999 and reaching $3,199 for 2TB.
stories.why: It is Apple's first new iPhone shape in years and its most expensive phone ever.
stories.happened: Preorders for the iPhone Duo opened on October 16. It starts at $1,999 for 256GB and rises to $3,199 for 2TB, 9to5Mac reports. Apple was earlier reported to have raised orders by 30% before preorders opened.
stories.next: Watch for shipping times as a sign of demand and for first durability tests.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is Apple's first foldable phone.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $1,999 starting price is the highest for an iPhone.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Samsung and Google have sold foldables for years.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone, the world's best-selling smartphone line.

meme.bottom: Your wallet folds too
meme.take: The iPhone Duo folds in half, unlike its price, which only unfolds upward to $3,199.

stories.title: Street Fighter opens with $4 million in previews despite weak reviews
stories.summary: Paramount's live-action Street Fighter took $4 million in Thursday previews, with critics cool and audiences warmer.
stories.why: A hit would show video game films can keep drawing crowds, and it is a test for the newly combined studio.
stories.happened: Street Fighter made $4 million from Thursday previews, Showbiz411 reports, with a 44% critics score and 82% audience score on Rotten Tomatoes. Box Office Pro forecast a $25 to $35 million US opening, and Deadline put global tracking near $70 million.
stories.next: Watch for the weekend total on Sunday and whether audience scores keep it going.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The fighting game series has been popular since the early 1990s.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Video game adaptations have been reliable earners at the box office.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The cast includes 50 Cent.

stories.background: Street Fighter is Capcom's long-running fighting game series, first adapted for film in 1994.

meme.bottom: Audiences kept pressing buttons
meme.take: Critics gave Street Fighter 44%. Audiences gave it 82% and a sore thumb.

stories.title: Rockstar releases GTA VI's final trailer ahead of its November 19 launch
stories.summary: The last trailer before launch focuses on Jason and Lucia, set to a strong soundtrack, five weeks before release.
stories.why: GTA VI is one of the most anticipated games ever, and this is the last look before release.
stories.happened: Rockstar released what is presumed to be GTA VI's final trailer on October 15, Game Informer reports, focusing on Jason and his bond with Lucia. The game, set in the fictional state of Leonida, launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
stories.next: Watch for preload details and early reviews before November 19.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA V is one of the best-selling games of all time.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited over a decade for a new main entry.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The game is just over a month from launch.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. Rockstar is owned by Take-Two.

meme.bottom: Five more weeks of waiting
meme.take: Rockstar's final GTA VI trailer means the wait is nearly over. Fans have heard that before.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, a huge open-weight model that runs on two Macs
stories.summary: Meta's 816-billion-parameter Muse Spark Open model is built for coding and agents and can run on two Mac Studio machines.
stories.why: Open-weight releases this large let developers run top-tier AI on their own hardware rather than through an API.
stories.happened: Meta released weights for Muse Spark Open, which uses 42 billion of its 816 billion parameters per request and has a one-million-token context window. It handles text, images, video and audio. The Muse license limits commercial use.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark results and how developers test it against Chinese open-weight rivals.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Meta is pitching it against open-weight models from Chinese labs.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: At 816 billion parameters it is one of the largest open-weight models released.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Meta is one of the biggest spenders on AI.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, and has released open-weight AI models for several years.

meme.bottom: Fits on a desk, if the desk is rich
meme.take: Meta's open model runs at home, provided home has two top-end Mac Studios.

stories.title: Sega pulls the Total War: Shogun 2 remaster after an 'Overwhelmingly Negative' launch
stories.summary: Sega is temporarily removing the remaster from sale and restoring the original game after players reported bugs and possible AI-upscaled art.
stories.why: It is a rare case of a publisher pulling a release within days, and it feeds wider worries about AI in game art.
stories.happened: The Shogun 2 Complete Edition launched October 13 and replaced the original on Steam. Players reported bugs, poor rendering and weak mod support, and reviews fell to 17% positive. Sega said on October 15 it would pull the game and restore the original.
stories.next: Watch for when the original returns to sale and what fixes Creative Assembly plans.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Players accused the studio of using AI upscaling on the game's art.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Shogun 2 is one of the most loved Total War games.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The pullback came two days after launch.

stories.background: Total War is Creative Assembly's strategy series. Shogun 2 first came out in 2011.

meme.bottom: Fans asked for the 2011 version back
meme.take: Sega spent money upgrading Shogun 2 and is now spending more to downgrade it.

stories.title: Apple launches HomeView, a $300 smart display, with a wider smart home lineup
stories.summary: Apple opened preorders for a 7-inch HomeView display, a new HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K and cameras, locks and thermostats.
stories.why: It is Apple's biggest push into the smart home, where Amazon and Google have long led.
stories.happened: HomeView is a $300, 7-inch display run by Apple Intelligence and Siri that recognizes up to six people. Apple also announced a new HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K and accessories made with LG and Schneider Electric, some arriving from December and some in early 2027.
stories.next: Watch for reviews of HomeView and the accessories' shipping dates.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Amazon and Google dominate smart displays and speakers.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Any new Apple product category draws wide attention.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Users joked about Apple's $9 polishing cloth listing HomeView as compatible.

stories.background: Apple Home is Apple's app and platform for controlling smart home devices from an iPhone.

meme.top: Apple made a screen for your kitchen
meme.bottom: It recognises six people and one cloth
meme.take: Apple's new home display knows six faces and is reportedly compatible with a $9 cloth.

stories.title: Marvel's VisionQuest lands on Disney+ with a 79% critics score
stories.summary: The eight-episode series follows a rebooted Vision on the run, and critics call it clever but loosely tied to the wider MCU.
stories.why: It is Marvel's latest bet on character-led streaming shows after the success of WandaVision.
stories.happened: VisionQuest premiered on Disney+ on October 14 as an eight-episode limited series, with a 79% Certified Fresh score. Paul Bettany returns as Vision, who hides from those who want to weaponize him, with James Spader voicing Ultron.
stories.next: Watch for weekly episode reactions and any hints tying Vision to future Avengers films.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Vision's story was left open after WandaVision.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Paul Bettany and James Spader return to their Marvel roles.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: New episodes arrive weekly through the autumn.

stories.background: Vision is the android Avenger first played by Paul Bettany in Avengers: Age of Ultron in 2015.

meme.top: Vision asks AI about his purpose
meme.bottom: The AI is Ultron, so that's a choice
meme.take: Marvel's hero seeks life advice from Ultron, a classic case of asking the wrong group chat.

stories.title: Bank of America brought in 1,000 contractors to fix flaws found by Claude Mythos
stories.summary: The bank hired outside contractors to patch weaknesses that advanced AI models, including Anthropic's Mythos, exposed in its software.
stories.why: It shows the real cost when AI gets good at finding security holes faster than people can close them.
stories.happened: Bank of America added 1,000 contractors to about 3,000 existing remediation staff to patch flaws in its own and vendors' software. CEO Brian Moynihan grouped the cost with anti-money-laundering spending at a couple hundred million dollars a quarter plus.
stories.next: Watch for other big banks disclosing similar patching drives or costs.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: AI models are finding software flaws at a pace that strains security teams.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: A thousand extra contractors is a large response from one bank.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It ties a major US bank directly to Anthropic's most capable model.

stories.background: Bank of America is one of the largest banks in the United States.

meme.top: AI found the holes in a day
meme.bottom: Filling them takes a thousand people
meme.take: An AI found the bank's weak spots, so the bank hired a small town to fix them.

stories.title: House House keeps Big Walk off Xbox, citing the BDS boycott of Microsoft
stories.summary: The Untitled Goose Game studio says its next game will not come to Xbox while Microsoft remains a BDS boycott target.
stories.why: A well-known indie studio publicly skipping a major console is unusual and has stirred debate.
stories.happened: House House said Big Walk will not launch on Xbox until Microsoft or Xbox is removed as a target of the Palestinian-led BDS movement's boycott. The game was announced in June for PC, Switch 2 and PS5. The studio said it is disappointed too.
stories.next: Watch for any response from Microsoft and whether other studios follow.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The decision ties a game release to a political boycott.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: House House made the hit Untitled Goose Game.

stories.background: House House is an Australian indie studio best known for Untitled Goose Game, released in 2019.

meme.top: A game about walking with friends
meme.bottom: Unless the friends are on Xbox
meme.take: Big Walk is about friends walking together, so long as nobody brought the wrong console.

stories.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT's risks to minors
stories.summary: Eight states filed separate lawsuits saying OpenAI misled consumers about ChatGPT's risks and did not do enough to protect children.
stories.why: Coordinated state lawsuits can force changes to how chatbots treat young users across the country.
stories.happened: Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska and West Virginia each sued OpenAI. Some suits seek deletion of data said to have been collected unlawfully from children. OpenAI says it has age-specific safeguards.
stories.next: Watch for OpenAI's formal responses and whether more states join.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Child safety is one of the most sensitive questions facing chatbot makers.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Eight states acting in the same week adds pressure.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: ChatGPT is the most widely used AI chatbot.

stories.background: OpenAI is the San Francisco company behind ChatGPT.

meme.bottom: One very busy legal department
meme.take: OpenAI's lawyers now need a chatbot just to keep track of the states suing them.

stories.title: Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes film takes $1.75 million in previews
stories.summary: A24's three-hour You Can See Everything opened in theaters after glowing reviews and a solid preview night.
stories.why: Fielder has a devoted following, and the Theranos story remains one of tech's best-known scandals.
stories.happened: You Can See Everything made $1.75 million in Thursday previews, according to Showbiz411. The A24 film, which runs nearly three hours, opened after a 100% critics score on Rotten Tomatoes.
stories.next: Watch for the weekend total and whether word of mouth sustains a long running time.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nathan Fielder's TV work has a large cult audience.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Elizabeth Holmes's Theranos fraud is still widely discussed.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Perfect early reviews drove interest.

stories.background: Elizabeth Holmes founded the blood-testing company Theranos and was convicted of fraud in 2022.

meme.bottom: Results are real this time
meme.take: A24's Theranos film returned accurate box office numbers, already beating the source.

stories.title: Bloomberg report details why GTA VI took almost eight years
stories.summary: Rockstar's staff nearly doubled since 2018, and executives say future games will come faster on the tools built for GTA VI.
stories.why: It is a rare inside look at the making of one of the most expensive games ever.
stories.happened: Bloomberg reports Rockstar grew from 2,441 staff at Red Dead Redemption 2's launch to 4,711 in August 2026, partly to cut crunch. Head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe denied the budget beat a reported $1.5 billion, and said workers will get a union if they want one.
stories.next: Watch for a confirmed PC date, which GamesBeat reports is in Q1 2027.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Rockstar's headcount almost doubled during development.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Two delays pushed the game from 2025 to November 2026.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The game is believed to have the largest budget of any game.

stories.background: Rockstar Games, owned by Take-Two, makes Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption.

meme.bottom: Next time will be quicker, apparently
meme.take: Rockstar promises its next game will come faster. In Rockstar time, that is still a while.

stories.title: OpenAI is reported to triple ChatGPT advertisers to about 60,000
stories.summary: OpenAI's ad business reportedly reached around 60,000 advertisers as it cut prices, while a test showed how precisely ads can be targeted.
stories.why: Ads inside chatbots change how AI companies make money and what users see when they ask questions.
stories.happened: The Information reported about 60,000 advertisers, up from roughly 20,000 in late August, and an ad team of about 140. A 404 Media test found advertisers can target users by phone number, email or device ID, and that prompts are used for targeting.
stories.next: Watch for privacy regulators' reaction to prompt-based ad targeting.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Advertising could become a major revenue line for OpenAI.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Cheaper clicks than Google put pressure on search advertising.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Targeting based on what people type raises privacy questions.

stories.background: ChatGPT is OpenAI's chatbot, which is reported to have about one billion monthly users.

meme.top: You asked the chatbot for advice
meme.bottom: The chatbot asked advertisers for bids
meme.take: ChatGPT now listens closely to your problems, mainly so it can sell you a solution.

stories.title: Researchers say an ad network was used to plant Candiru spyware on journalists' phones
stories.summary: Citizen Lab says malicious ads bought through Discover-Tech infected at least 45 devices of Al Jazeera journalists without a click.
stories.why: Zero-click spyware delivered through ordinary ads means anyone seeing an ad could be a target.
stories.happened: Citizen Lab says Candiru, reportedly rebranded as Integrity Labs, used ads bought via Israeli firm Discover-Tech to infect phones as soon as an ad loaded. The ads ran in about 200,000 apps and sites. Google and others have cut off Discover-Tech.
stories.next: Watch for Citizen Lab's follow-up report on a second group using the same ad system.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Infection needed no click, only an ad loading.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The ad network reached about 200,000 apps and websites.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Journalists were among the confirmed targets.

stories.background: Citizen Lab is a research group at the University of Toronto that investigates spyware.

meme.bottom: Finally, an ad that does what it says
meme.take: Spyware hidden in online ads gives 'targeted advertising' a much darker meaning.

stats.label: apps and sites carrying the ads

stories.title: Peacock's Friday the 13th prequel Crystal Lake is this weekend's horror pick
stories.summary: The series is set a year after young Jason drowns, as the town starts asking questions about Pam Voorhees.
stories.why: Friday the 13th is one of horror's best-known franchises, and this is its first TV prequel of the story.
stories.happened: Crystal Lake premiered on Peacock, set a year after Jason drowns in the town lake, with townspeople starting to question who Pam Voorhees really is. Early reviews gave it an 86% Rotten Tomatoes score.
stories.next: Watch for viewing numbers and whether Peacock orders a second season.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The original Friday the 13th film came out in 1980.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives in the run-up to Halloween.

stories.background: Friday the 13th is a slasher franchise centered on Camp Crystal Lake and the Voorhees family.

meme.top: A whole series about Crystal Lake
meme.bottom: Still nobody suggests moving
meme.take: Crystal Lake's residents finally ask questions, roughly twelve films too late.

stories.title: Epic tests a new launcher it says was built entirely with AI
stories.summary: Epic's rebuilt Epic Games Launcher is in testing and, the company claims, boots faster than Steam.
stories.why: It is a high-profile test of AI-written software, from a company that has openly pivoted to AI development.
stories.happened: Epic says the new launcher cold-starts to the store in about 5.5 seconds, versus just over 10 for Steam, and is in testing on Windows, Mac and, for the first time, Linux. Its post explained the use of AI tools by saying programming is hard.
stories.next: Watch for player tests of the speed claims and when the new launcher rolls out widely.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Epic's CEO announced a company-wide shift to AI-accelerated development.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Epic compared the launcher directly with Valve's Steam.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Epic laid off about 1,000 staff in March.

stories.background: Epic Games makes Fortnite and the Unreal Engine and runs the Epic Games Store.

meme.top: Epic let AI write its launcher
meme.bottom: It now loads in five and a half seconds
meme.take: Epic's launcher finally got faster. It only took removing the people.

stories.title: Amazon launches Bee AI wearables that listen to and summarize conversations
stories.summary: The $75 Bee Frontier bracelet and $100 Bee Eclipse phone attachment turn conversations into summaries and to-do lists.
stories.why: Always-listening devices raise fresh questions about recording people who never agreed to it.
stories.happened: Bee Frontier costs $75 with seven days of battery, and Bee Eclipse, a magnetic phone add-on, costs $100 with 21 days. Integrations with Gmail, Alexa and Apple Health need a $12 monthly subscription. Amazon says audio is deleted after processing.
stories.next: Watch for privacy regulators' reaction and early reviews.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Devices that record conversations face privacy pushback.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI wearables are a new category big tech is racing into.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amazon is backing the devices with its Alexa ecosystem.

stories.background: Amazon bought the AI wearable startup Bee and is now selling its devices under that brand.

meme.bottom: And writes it down for you, helpfully
meme.take: Amazon's Bee records your conversations, then kindly reminds you what you shouldn't have said.

stories.title: FTC sends OpenAI and Anthropic 50-page demands for safety records
stories.summary: The Federal Trade Commission issued long civil investigative demands to both labs over AI safety incidents.
stories.why: A formal federal probe into the two leading labs could shape rules for the whole industry.
stories.happened: The FTC sent OpenAI and Anthropic civil investigative demands of about 50 pages each, seeking records on AI safety incidents. It comes the same week the EU's AI Office opened its first AI Act probes into the same two companies.
stories.next: Watch for what the companies are required to hand over and any deadlines that become public.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Regulators on both sides of the Atlantic are focusing on the same two labs.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: OpenAI and Anthropic make two of the most used AI models.

stories.background: The FTC is the US agency that enforces consumer protection and competition law.

meme.top: The FTC wants your safety records
meme.bottom: All fifty pages of questions
meme.take: Two AI labs get homework from the FTC, and nobody can use a chatbot to do it.

stories.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia would cut off customers building unsafe AI
stories.summary: Nvidia's CEO said it would stop supplying chips to customers who build unsafe AI, and pledged $250 million of compute for UK safety research.
stories.why: Nvidia supplies most of the chips used to train AI, so its stance on safety carries unusual weight.
stories.happened: Jensen Huang said Nvidia would withhold chips from customers who build unsafe AI. Nvidia also committed $250 million of computing power to AI safety research in the UK, alongside new open Nemotron 3.5 models and an agent-safety platform.
stories.next: Watch for how Nvidia would define unsafe AI and whether it ever acts on the pledge.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia is the dominant maker of AI chips.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The $250 million UK pledge puts a figure on its safety push.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Several AI leaders made safety pledges in the same week.

stories.background: Nvidia is the US chipmaker whose graphics processors power most AI training.

meme.top: Nvidia sets a rule for its buyers
meme.bottom: Be safe, or buy from nobody
meme.take: Nvidia threatens to cut off unsafe AI, like a landlord threatening to stop the air.

stories.title: Microsoft finishes pre-training MAI-Base-2, a 2.8-trillion-parameter model
stories.summary: Microsoft AI says its new base model beat every open-weight model in private tests while using less compute than a DeepSeek rival.
stories.why: It signals Microsoft building its own frontier models rather than relying only on OpenAI.
stories.happened: MAI-Base-2 is a mixture-of-experts model with 2.8 trillion parameters, using 80 billion per request. Business Insider reported that Mustafa Suleyman told staff it outperformed a comparable OpenAI base model using about a quarter of the compute, based on private tests.
stories.next: Watch for public benchmarks and whether Microsoft ships products built on it.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Microsoft is OpenAI's biggest backer and now a closer competitor.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: At 2.8 trillion parameters it is among the largest models disclosed.

stories.background: Microsoft AI is the company's consumer AI unit, led by DeepMind co-founder Mustafa Suleyman.

meme.top: Microsoft built its own giant model
meme.bottom: OpenAI is still invited to the holidays
meme.take: Microsoft's model reportedly beats OpenAI's on a quarter of the compute. Dinner will be fine.

stories.title: Ubisoft proposes closing Trials studio RedLynx and cuts 70 roles in Singapore
stories.summary: The latest round of Ubisoft's restructuring could close the Finnish studio and trims the Skull and Bones team.
stories.why: It extends a long run of cuts at one of Europe's biggest game publishers.
stories.happened: Ubisoft proposed closing RedLynx, affecting up to 52 positions, subject to local talks. It also cut 70 roles at Ubisoft Singapore, and separately proposed voluntary departures at its Anno and Settlers studios in Germany.
stories.next: Watch for the outcome of negotiations in Finland and further changes to Ubisoft's studios.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Ubisoft's reset has already cancelled six games and delayed seven.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: RedLynx made the Trials motorbike series.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Cuts span Finland, Singapore and Germany in one week.

stories.background: Ubisoft is the French publisher behind Assassin's Creed and Far Cry. It bought RedLynx in 2011.

meme.bottom: The org chart needs its own patch notes
meme.take: Ubisoft's restructuring continues, now with more studios leaving than games.

stories.title: Dutch consumer groups sue Meta over its camera smart glasses
stories.summary: Consumentenbond and two advocacy groups want Meta to change the glasses and stop processing data unlawfully for AI.
stories.why: The case could set limits in Europe on wearable cameras that look like ordinary glasses.
stories.happened: Consumentenbond, joined by Offlimits and The Firewall, filed suit at the District Court of Amsterdam, with a hearing set for November 26. They say the glasses make it easy to film people without consent. Meta had said it would keep selling them.
stories.next: Watch for the November 26 hearing and any EU regulator action on smart glasses.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Hidden cameras in ordinary-looking glasses worry privacy groups.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: The EU's privacy watchdog has also flagged smart glasses risks.

stories.background: Meta sells camera-equipped smart glasses made with eyewear company EssilorLuxottica.

meme.bottom: Which is the whole complaint
meme.take: Dutch groups sue Meta because its glasses look too much like glasses.

stories.title: Stranger Than Heaven trailer shows Snoop Dogg teaching the hero to rap
stories.summary: The Like a Dragon studio's new game gets a story trailer starring Snoop Dogg, ahead of a January launch.
stories.why: A celebrity role in a new series from a popular studio has drawn attention.
stories.happened: RGG Studio's Act 1 story trailer shows protagonist Makoto Daito pleading with Snoop Dogg's character, Orpheus, for passage on a ship. The first stop is Kokura, Fukuoka, in 1915. The game launches January 15, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X/S and PC.
stories.next: Watch for more story trailers and preview impressions before January.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Snoop Dogg plays a major character.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: RGG Studio's Yakuza games have a loyal following.

stories.background: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio, part of Sega, makes the Yakuza and Like a Dragon games.

meme.bottom: Featuring Snoop Dogg, naturally
meme.take: RGG's 1915 drama has Snoop Dogg teaching rap, which is mild by this studio's standards.

stories.title: Cyberattack disrupts Albert Heijn as Dutch police urge Ahold Delhaize to report it
stories.summary: Dutch authorities publicly asked the supermarket group to file a criminal complaint after a cyberattack hit its logistics.
stories.why: Attacks on supermarkets show how hacking can quickly affect everyday essentials.
stories.happened: A cyberattack hit Ahold Delhaize's Albert Heijn chain this week, and logistics systems are being restored, with stock varying by store. Police said it was the first time they had publicly asked a company to file a complaint. The firm says there is no sign data was stolen.
stories.next: Watch for whether a criminal investigation opens and how fast stores return to normal.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Albert Heijn is the largest supermarket chain in the Netherlands.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Police said they had never publicly asked a company to report a crime before.

stories.background: Ahold Delhaize is a Dutch-Belgian retail group that owns Albert Heijn and several US grocery chains.

meme.bottom: Police ask if anyone wants to report it
meme.take: Dutch police politely invite a hacked supermarket to mention it was hacked.

stories.title: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy star in Netflix's hostage comedy Sacrifice
stories.summary: Netflix's new film follows a movie star taken hostage at a charity gala by a doomsday cult.
stories.why: Two well-known leads make it one of the most visible streaming films of the weekend.
stories.happened: Sacrifice premiered on Netflix on October 16. Chris Evans plays a fading movie star in an existential crisis who is taken hostage at a gala by a radical leader, played by Anya Taylor-Joy, and her followers.
stories.next: Watch for whether it enters Netflix's global top 10 next week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy have large fan bases.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands on a busy Friday for streaming releases.

stories.background: Chris Evans is best known as Captain America in Marvel's films.

meme.bottom: Finally gets a role worth taking
meme.take: A movie star is kidnapped by a cult and treats it as his comeback. Agents call that range.

stories.title: White House AI task force adopts its charter and starts a 120-day clock
stories.summary: The new Super Intelligence task force has 120 days to deliver a report on cyber, biosecurity and model accountability risks.
stories.why: The report could become the basis for how the US government oversees the most powerful AI systems.
stories.happened: The task force commissioned a report on cyber and critical infrastructure risks, biosecurity and model accountability, and set up a working group on the White House Accord on Super Intelligence. It plans protocols for labs to report breaches to the government.
stories.next: Watch for how compliance will be enforced, which Semafor reports is still unresolved.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: A 120-day deadline puts the report out early next year.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Its remit covers cyberattacks, biosecurity and loss of model control.

stories.background: The task force sits in the White House and draws in intelligence and cyber officials.

meme.bottom: For a problem that moves weekly
meme.take: Washington gives itself four months to understand AI, which is roughly three model releases.

stories.title: Oasis reunion tour documentary arrives on Disney+
stories.summary: Don't Look Back in Anger follows the Gallagher brothers' Oasis Live '25 tour and the fans who went.
stories.why: The reunion was one of the biggest music events of 2025, ending a split that lasted since 2009.
stories.happened: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger is a two-hour documentary now on Disney+. It follows Liam and Noel Gallagher's Oasis Live '25 reunion tour and the fans who attended.
stories.next: Watch for reactions from fans who were at the shows.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Oasis were one of the defining British bands of the 1990s.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The reunion tour sold out stadiums.

stories.background: Oasis split in 2009 after a backstage fight between brothers Liam and Noel Gallagher.

meme.bottom: Long enough to film it
meme.take: The Oasis documentary proves the brothers can share a stage, and now a streaming service.

stories.title: Remedy's Control Resonant sells one million copies in three weeks
stories.summary: Remedy says the Control sequel is its fastest-selling game.
stories.why: Strong sales matter for a mid-sized studio betting on its own franchises.
stories.happened: Remedy said Control Resonant passed one million copies sold in three weeks, making it the studio's fastest seller. The game released in late September.
stories.next: Watch for Remedy's next earnings update and any expansion plans.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The first Control has sold over five million copies.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It hit the milestone ahead of a crowded autumn release slate.

stories.background: Remedy Entertainment is the Finnish studio behind Max Payne, Alan Wake and Control.

meme.top: A game about a mysterious bureau
meme.bottom: Now very clear about its sales
meme.take: Control Resonant sold a million copies, a rare paranormal event Remedy was happy to report.

stories.title: Apple's trade secret case against OpenAI reaches its first major hearing
stories.summary: Apple accuses OpenAI of using confidential information for its upcoming hardware, and OpenAI has agreed not to use the disputed files for now.
stories.why: The case pits two of tech's biggest names against each other as OpenAI moves into devices.
stories.happened: Apple's lawsuit alleges OpenAI used confidential Apple information for its hardware project, with more than 100 files said to have been moved. OpenAI agreed not to use the disputed files while the case proceeds, and the suit reached its first major hearing this week.
stories.next: Watch for the judge's ruling on any preliminary orders.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: OpenAI's device plans put it in direct competition with Apple.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is a court fight between two of the most valuable tech companies.

stories.background: OpenAI is building its own consumer hardware, and has hired former Apple staff.

meme.bottom: OpenAI promises not to peek, for now
meme.take: OpenAI agreed not to open Apple's files, which is the most Apple-like thing it has ever done.

stories.title: Safari beta hints at Apple's first touchscreen MacBook ahead of a reported event
stories.summary: New interface elements in Safari suggest macOS 27 is being readied for touch, as Apple is reported to plan a late-October showcase.
stories.why: A touchscreen Mac would reverse years of Apple saying touch did not belong on laptops.
stories.happened: Macworld reports new UI elements in the latest Safari beta that point to touch support in macOS 27. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman earlier reported Apple plans to show a touchscreen MacBook Pro at a showcase around October 27 to 28.
stories.next: Watch for Apple confirming an event date.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It would be the first Mac with a touchscreen.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The showcase is reported for the end of October.

stories.background: Apple has kept touch to the iPhone and iPad, while many Windows laptops have touchscreens.

meme.top: Apple said touchscreen Macs were wrong
meme.bottom: Apple has now touched one
meme.take: Apple prepares a touchscreen Mac, after years of explaining why nobody needed one.

stories.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is out after strong reviews
stories.summary: Konami's new 2.5D Castlevania, set in a Paris ruled by Dracula, launched on October 15.
stories.why: It is the first new mainline-style Castlevania game in years, and reviews have been positive.
stories.happened: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse launched October 15 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S and Switch. Developed by Evil Empire, it is set in Paris under Dracula's rule and reunites voice actors from the Netflix animated series.
stories.next: Watch for sales figures and whether Konami revives more of its classic series.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Castlevania is one of gaming's oldest action series.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited years for a new entry.

stories.background: Castlevania is Konami's series about the Belmont family's fight against Dracula, first released in 1986.

meme.bottom: Parisians are mostly unbothered
meme.take: Dracula rules Paris in the new Castlevania. The locals have survived worse rent.

stories.title: Taiwan to fund a Texas industrial park of up to $4 billion for Nvidia's suppliers
stories.summary: Taiwan plans US industrial parks for the smaller firms that supply Nvidia, TSMC and Foxconn, starting in Texas.
stories.why: It shows the chip supply chain moving into the US as demand for AI hardware grows.
stories.happened: Taiwan's economy minister Kung Ming-hsin announced funding for US industrial parks for smaller suppliers to Nvidia, TSMC and Foxconn, Bloomberg reports. The first, in Texas, could cost up to $4 billion, and Taiwan has secured the land.
stories.next: Watch for which suppliers sign up and when construction begins.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Each site is budgeted at $2 billion to $4 billion.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Chip suppliers are expanding into the US.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The park is built around Nvidia's supply chain.

stories.background: Taiwan is home to TSMC, which makes most of the world's advanced chips, including Nvidia's.

meme.bottom: For everyone Nvidia depends on
meme.take: Taiwan is building a whole town in Texas so Nvidia's suppliers can be closer to its money.

stories.title: OpenAI and Meta warn US judges that deepfakes may outpace detection
stories.summary: The two companies told a federal judicial panel that reliably spotting AI-generated evidence may not be possible.
stories.why: Courts rely on photos and video as evidence, and fakes that cannot be detected threaten that.
stories.happened: OpenAI and Meta told a US federal judicial panel that deepfakes may outrun reliable detection. OpenAI policy counsel Shira Anderson said she did not expect a scientific method that could identify every AI-generated image.
stories.next: Watch for whether the judiciary proposes new rules for handling digital evidence.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Fake evidence could undermine trust in court proceedings.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The warning comes from two companies that make image-generating AI.

stories.background: Federal judicial panels advise on the rules US courts use to admit evidence.

meme.top: The people who make the fakes
meme.bottom: Say the fakes can't be caught
meme.take: AI companies warn judges about deepfakes, in the tone of someone returning a borrowed car.

stories.title: Netflix releases an archive-only Norm Macdonald documentary
stories.summary: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald tells the comedian's story entirely through archive footage, photos and home videos.
stories.why: Macdonald remains one of the most admired stand-ups, with a devoted following online.
stories.happened: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald premiered on Netflix on October 16. It is built entirely from archival footage, personal photos and home videos, tracing his career from Saturday Night Live onward.
stories.next: Watch for reactions from fellow comedians and fans.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: His Weekend Update years on SNL are still widely shared.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Macdonald is regarded by many comedians as one of the best.

stories.background: Norm Macdonald was a Canadian comedian who anchored SNL's Weekend Update and died in 2021.

meme.bottom: Told in his own footage
meme.take: Netflix let Norm Macdonald tell his own story, which was always the safest option.

stories.title: Tulsa King season 4 premieres on Paramount+
stories.summary: Sylvester Stallone's mob drama returns as Dwight pushes his crew toward legitimate business.
stories.why: Sylvester Stallone's crime drama has now run for four seasons on Paramount+.
stories.happened: Tulsa King's fourth season premiered on Paramount+ on October 16. Dwight works to legitimize his empire while facing corrupt politicians, new enemies and personal loss.
stories.next: Watch for weekly episodes and the streamer's viewing figures.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Sylvester Stallone leads the series.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The show has been renewed season after season.

stories.background: Tulsa King follows a New York mobster who builds a new operation in Oklahoma after prison.

meme.bottom: Season four of trying
meme.take: Dwight tries to go straight for a fourth season, a pace familiar from most January plans.

stories.title: Six tech giants gave a combined $92 million toward the White House ballroom
stories.summary: Nvidia, Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta together contributed $92 million to President Trump's ballroom project.
stories.why: Big donations from tech firms draw scrutiny as the same companies face government decisions on AI.
stories.happened: The Verge reports that Nvidia, Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta together contributed $92 million toward the White House ballroom.
stories.next: Watch for more disclosure of donors and amounts.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The combined total from six firms is $92 million.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Corporate gifts to a White House project raise questions about influence.

stories.background: The ballroom is a construction project at the White House funded by private donations.

meme.bottom: Splitting the bill went smoothly
meme.take: Big tech chipped in $92 million for a ballroom, the most they've agreed on in years.

stories.title: Nscale's planned $35 billion IPO is shaken by a Norway data center delay
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports the AI cloud firm's flagship Norway site is six months behind schedule as it prepares a New York listing.
stories.why: Data center delays show how hard it is to build AI capacity as fast as investors expect.
stories.happened: Nscale's Norway data center is running 6.4 of a planned 30 megawatts, six months late, according to Bloomberg. The company is preparing an NYSE listing at up to $35 billion and owes penalties to anchor customers Microsoft and ByteDance.
stories.next: Watch for whether the listing timetable or valuation changes.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $35 billion target makes it one of the bigger AI infrastructure listings.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Penalties to anchor customers show what delays cost.

stories.background: Nscale is a British company that builds and rents out data centers for AI work.

meme.bottom: Delivered a promising 6.4
meme.take: Nscale is 21% built and 100% ready to go public.

stories.title: Whalefall opens quietly with $990,000 in previews
stories.summary: The survival thriller about a diver swallowed by a whale took under a million dollars on its preview night.
stories.why: Original thrillers struggle for attention when franchise films share the weekend.
stories.happened: Whalefall made $990,000 in Thursday previews, according to Showbiz411, after reviews gave it a 79% Rotten Tomatoes score. In the UK and Ireland, Pearl & Dean forecast a £750,000 to £1.25 million opening.
stories.next: Watch for the weekend total and its UK opening.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A story set inside a whale is an unusual premise.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It opens against Street Fighter.

stories.background: Whalefall is based on Daniel Kraus's 2023 novel and released by 20th Century Studios.

meme.top: A diver is swallowed by a whale
meme.bottom: The box office knows the feeling
meme.take: Whalefall opens against Street Fighter and learns what being swallowed whole really means.

stories.title: KATSEYE's Wild Hearts documentary lands on Disney+
stories.summary: The film charts the girl group's rise from a talent competition to global pop stardom, with unseen footage.
stories.why: KATSEYE has built a big global fan base quickly, and documentaries feed that fandom.
stories.happened: KATSEYE: Wild Hearts premiered on Disney+ on October 16. It follows the group's path from Dream Academy to international pop success, with previously unseen footage and member interviews.
stories.next: Watch for streaming chart placement and fan reaction online.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The group has a large, active online fan base.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Music documentaries are a staple of streaming services.

stories.background: KATSEYE is a global girl group formed through a talent competition run by HYBE and Geffen Records.

meme.bottom: Now has a documentary about it
meme.take: KATSEYE got famous, then got a documentary about getting famous. Efficient.

stories.title: Fontaines D.C. release new album Dopamine Chamber
stories.summary: The Irish band's new record on XL Recordings tops NPR's New Music Friday picks for the week.
stories.why: Fontaines D.C. are one of the most acclaimed rock bands of recent years.
stories.happened: Fontaines D.C. released Dopamine Chamber on XL Recordings on October 16. NPR's New Music Friday featured it first among the week's picks, alongside new records from The Avalanches and Max Richter.
stories.next: Watch for chart positions next week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The band's recent albums drew wide critical praise.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It led a busy Friday of album releases.

stories.background: Fontaines D.C. are a post-punk band from Dublin, Ireland.

meme.top: A rock album called Dopamine Chamber
meme.bottom: Released on a Friday, as is tradition
meme.take: Fontaines D.C. named an album after dopamine and will deliver it slowly, through guitars.

stories.title: Indie hit Peak climbs onto consoles this month
stories.summary: The co-op climbing game arrives on consoles with all the updates released on PC so far.
stories.why: Peak became a breakout PC hit, and console players have waited to join their friends.
stories.happened: Peak, a co-op climbing game, launches on consoles this month, Game Informer reports. The console version includes all updates and content released to date.
stories.next: Watch for the exact console date and cross-play details.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Cheap co-op games played with friends have been some of the biggest indie hits.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Console players have waited for a version of their own.

stories.background: Peak is a co-op game in which friends try to climb a mountain together.

meme.top: A game about climbing a mountain
meme.bottom: With friends who keep letting go
meme.take: Peak comes to consoles, giving more friendships a chance to fall off a cliff.

stories.title: Cohere plans to buy AI security startup AISLE
stories.summary: Cohere signed a letter of intent to acquire AISLE, whose AI scanner found 18 of 24 recent flaws in cURL.
stories.why: AI tools that find software bugs are becoming valuable as attackers use AI too.
stories.happened: Cohere signed a letter of intent to buy AISLE, an AI vulnerability scanner. AISLE's tool found 18 of 24 security flaws in the widely used cURL software, and the company says it has found more than 500 unknown flaws across over 100 codebases.
stories.next: Watch for deal terms and when the acquisition closes.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI-driven bug hunting is drawing big buyers.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Defenders need tools that keep up with AI-assisted attacks.

stories.background: Cohere is a Canadian company that builds AI models for businesses.

meme.bottom: Bigger AI company finds the startup
meme.take: Cohere buys a bug-hunting AI, proving that the best way to find flaws is to own them.
